images.caption: Chrome Island Light shows at the centre of the photograph just off the south tip of Denman Island.  Vancouver Island is in the foreground and Hornby Island and the Straits of Georgia are in the background. The high point on Hornby Island is Mount Geoffrey. Facing roughly North or North-West.  These islands are off the coast of British Columbia, Canada. The passage to the near left is Baynes Sound, the passage between Denman Island and Hornby Island is Lambert Channel.

images.caption: This is a photo I took December 27, 2005.  It shows Deep Bay Harbour (Marina) surrounded by the Deep Bay Spit.  The south tip of Hornby Island with Chrome Island Light off its end is above and Denman Island is in the background.  The  streaks in the bottom of the photo are an Oyster Farm.  Deep Bay is on Vancouver Island and is part of British Columbia Canada. The water off Deep Bay is Baynes Sound between Vancouver Island and Denman Island. The photo is taken roughly East. images.caption: Chrome Island Lighthouse off Denman Island, British Columbia taken from Ford Cove, Hornby Island.  The Strait of Georgia runs south (to the left) from Chrome Island.  Baynes Sound is to the right of Chrome Island along the far shoreline of Vancouver Island. The water below Chrome Island is Lambert Channel.
images.alt: Chrome Island Lighthouse off Denman Island, British Columbia taken from Ford Cove, Hornby Island.  The Strait of Georgia runs south (to the left) from Chrome Island.  Baynes Sound is to the right of Chrome Island along the far shoreline of Vancouver Island. The water below Chrome Island is Lambert Channel.

images.caption: Chrome Island Lighthouse on the small island of the same name lies at the north end of Denman Island where the waters of Baynes Sound (between Vancouver Island and Denman Island) and the Lambert Channel (between Denman Island and Hornby Island meet the Strait of Georgia which lies to the south (right side of photo).  The mountains in the background are on the mainland coast of British Columbia in the area of Desolation Sound.
